_note: Event-driven automation subscriptions (ADR-006). Each entry becomes a Zoho CRM change-notification channel that pushes record events to our Catalyst function, replacing console-configured workflow rules. Provisioned by functions/zoho/provision-notifications.mjs. The notify_url is NOT stored here — it is environment-specific and comes from ZOHO_NOTIFY_URL, so the same config drives dev/staging/prod.
_channel_expiry: Zoho notification channels EXPIRE. renewal_hours must be comfortably shorter than expiry_hours so a renewal job always runs before a channel lapses; if a channel lapses, automation stops SILENTLY. Renewal is an operational requirement, not an optimisation.
